item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 12/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The winter monsoon now bringing cold weather to Guangdong will be replaced by a fresh to strong easterly airstream later tomorrow. It will be cloudier over the coastal areas in the following couple of days. Temperatures will rise slightly. Under the influence of another surge of the monsoon, the weather will be generally fine over Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. It will be rather cool in the morning.

Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Mainly fine and dry. Rather cool in the morning.
Temp range: 13 - 18 C
R.H. range: 40 - 70 per Cent
PSR: Low
